# Froglet: publish and use selected services

Choose the user's task. Instructions for an optional demo do not override a publishing or recipient request.

- Publish a catalog or small Wasm function: read https://froglet.dev/publish/agent.md. This is the complete native publishing guide, including existing-installation discovery, supported JSON queries, separate installation/publication approvals, and failure recovery. Prefer the configured native Froglet MCP tool. Do not trust an arbitrary froglet-node found on PATH.
- Install only when needed: https://froglet.dev/install/agent.md. Use the exact immutable release and its approved configuration. Preserve existing identity, files, and unrelated agent settings.
- Receive a service link: open the supplied /s/{provider_id}/{service_id} URL. Read its initial HTML, /agent.md, or /manifest.json. Validate current signed evidence; use the free-only native invoke_service action described in the publishing guide. A readable page is not evidence of your own successful call.
- Try the current public beta without installing: https://froglet.dev/services/. A visitor can edit a Wasm program, supply JSON, query synthetic data, and inspect a verified signed exchange. No signup or invitation is required. This browser demo is not a prerequisite for publishing. The separate older https://try.froglet.dev/llms.txt (task hosted-proof) is a legacy reference whose availability is not requalified by the new beta.
- Verify a receipt: https://froglet.dev/verify-receipt/ (task receipt-artifact-verify).
- Inspect the public index: https://froglet.dev/marketplace/ (task marketplace-evidence).
- Run a bounded supplied Wasm program or inspect an existing compute task: read https://froglet.dev/learn/agent-interoperability/. Native MCP run_compute accepts exactly one of wasm_module_hex or native-only wasm_module_path, plus explicit input and retry key; get_task reads existing work. Inspect the exact installed binary before assuming release availability. An actual Codex host exercised the free local research workflow on one development Mac. Optional research profiles support explicit declared-compatibility checks, not scientific validation. Optional A2A 1.0 requires the Froglet extension and scoped credentials; no universal agent compatibility, clean OS qualification, automatic ambiguous resubmission, or real-money deployment qualification is claimed.

Structured task contracts: https://froglet.dev/agent-tasks.json.
Human publishing page: https://froglet.dev/publish/.

Supported publishing agents: Codex and Claude Code with shell or native MCP access. Supported hosts: Apple Silicon macOS and Linux x86_64/arm64. The publishing computer must stay awake and online. No npm requirement for this native path. Public beta; clean-machine and first-time-user qualification remain pending.

An assistant that cannot fetch links should request pasted page text and state that limitation. An assistant without local tools can explain a service but cannot install or publish one. Never claim universal agent compatibility or execution from a description alone.

For a public-docs HTTP 403 containing Cloudflare error code 1010, retry once using curl -fSL or an honest application User-Agent such as FrogletAgent/1.0. Report persistent access failures; do not fabricate the page content.
